filter.description: See [Advanced Log Filters](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/advanced-filters) for information on how to write a filter. The filter that determines which log entries to exclude.
filter.rationale: Carefully crafted filters are essential to avoid excluding security-relevant logs while reducing noise from non-essential logs.

name.description: The name of the logging exclusion. Must be unique within the project. Names can contain only letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
name.rationale: Proper naming helps identify the purpose of log exclusions and maintain organizational standards for security monitoring.

description.description: A description of the exclusion, which explains why certain logs are being excluded. This helps maintain auditability of exclusion rules.
description.rationale: Clear descriptions provide justification for exclusions and help maintain security audit trails.
description.compliant: Excludes health check logs to reduce noise in security monitoring

disabled.description: If set to true, the exclusion is disabled and does not exclude any log entries. Default is false.
disabled.rationale: Unexpected enabling/disabling of exclusions can affect security monitoring by either including sensitive data or excluding security-relevant logs.

project.description: The project ID where the exclusion should be created. If not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Proper project specification ensures exclusions are created in the correct project context with appropriate access controls.
